pages: Winifred Pike, about thirty, dark hair pinned back, a dark green wool coat over a high-necked blouse, a long skirt, stands at the office wall with one finger on a large paper catchment map, her satchel on the floor. Middle distance: a brass barometer, a fire bucket, a wooden chair. Background: the sash window, low July sun.

Winifred Pike, about thirty, dark hair pinned back, a dark green wool coat over a high-necked blouse, a long skirt, holds one foolscap return sheet up to the office light, head tilted at it. Middle distance: the deal box under the window, an inkwell, a blotter. Background: the office shelves, flat window light.

Winifred Pike, about thirty, dark hair pinned back, a dark green wool coat over a high-necked blouse, a long skirt, lifts one field notebook out of a deal box, holding it open at the inside cover. Middle distance: a stack of more notebooks, a brass rule, a glass collecting bottle. Background: the office sill, morning light.

Winifred Pike, about thirty, dark hair pinned back, a dark green wool coat over a high-necked blouse, a long skirt, runs one finger down a pencilled line on the open inside cover of a field notebook. Middle distance: a pencil stub, the deal box lid, a brass rule. Background: the office window, soft morning light.

Winifred Pike, about thirty, dark hair pinned back, a dark green wool coat over a high-necked blouse, a long skirt, turns one field notebook back and lays a finger on two matching entries. Middle distance: a pencil stub, the deal box, a brass rule. Background: the office shelves, flat window light.

Winifred Pike, about thirty, dark hair pinned back, a dark green wool coat over a high-necked blouse, a long skirt, holds one notebook open to two soft brown leaves, the edges furred and crumbling. Middle distance: a dry brush, the deal box lid, a glass bottle on the sill. Background: the office window, cold grey light.

Winifred Pike, about thirty, dark hair pinned back, a dark green wool coat over a high-necked blouse, a long skirt, works at a kitchen table with one notebook open beside a second, a lamp at her elbow. Middle distance: a pencil, a teacup, a squared sheet of paper. Background: the kitchen range, night dark at the window.

Winifred Pike, about thirty, dark hair pinned back, a dark green wool coat over a high-necked blouse, a long skirt, writes one column of figures down the margin of a sheet and rules a line under it. Middle distance: two open field notebooks, an inkwell, a blotter. Background: the kitchen table edge, lamplight, a dark window.

Winifred Pike, about thirty, dark hair pinned back, a dark green wool coat over a high-necked blouse, a long skirt, sits at the office desk with one foolscap return sheet held flat under a steel rule, a lamp at her shoulder. Middle distance: a brass barometer, an inkwell, the wall map. Background: the sash window, dusk.

Winifred Pike, about thirty, dark hair pinned back, a dark green wool coat over a high-necked blouse, a long skirt, walks the short cropped grass of the moor shoulder with one hundred-foot tape running from her hand. Middle distance: the beck below, the reservoir wall, a concrete block in the turf. Background: the fell coming over, wide wet sky.

Winifred Pike, about thirty, dark hair pinned back, a dark green wool coat over a high-necked blouse, a long skirt, paces towards a row of tall larches with one hundred-foot tape trailing from her hand. Middle distance: a copper funnel in its block, wind combing the grass. Background: the moor shoulder, the beck in the valley, low grey cloud.

Winifred Pike, about thirty, dark hair pinned back, a dark green wool coat over a high-necked blouse, a long skirt, kneels on the wet grass and lays one steel rule across the rim of a copper funnel. Middle distance: a concrete block, a glass collecting bottle, grass pressed flat. Background: open moor, flat overcast light.

Winifred Pike, about thirty, dark hair pinned back, a dark green wool coat over a high-necked blouse, a long skirt, stops in a ploughed market-garden field with one boot beside a lead flange set in a concrete block. Middle distance: a ringed dead stump, a garden fork, rows of cut cabbages. Background: the reservoir wall, flat July light.

Winifred Pike, about thirty, dark hair pinned back, a dark green wool coat over a high-necked blouse, a long skirt, stands in the ploughed field beside one ringed dead tree stump, measuring across to the concrete block. Middle distance: the lead flange, rows of cut cabbages, a garden fork. Background: the reservoir wall and the moor above, high thin light.

Winifred Pike, about thirty, dark hair pinned back, a dark green wool coat over a high-necked blouse, a long skirt, kneels to look level at one copper rain funnel standing in the ploughed field, the glass bottle beneath it. Middle distance: the lead flange and block, cut cabbage rows. Background: the ringed stump under the hedge, bright summer light.

Winifred Pike, about thirty, dark hair pinned back, a dark green wool coat over a high-necked blouse, a long skirt, stands before a long committee table with one thick return held flat against her chest. Middle distance: a water jug and glasses, wooden chairs, a table inkwell. Background: the tall windows of the committee room, flat July light.

Winifred Pike, about thirty, dark hair pinned back, a dark green wool coat over a high-necked blouse, a long skirt, sits at a table with one loose sheet held flat, a finger resting on a column of pencilled dates. Middle distance: the bound return, an inkwell, a water glass. Background: the committee room window, flat daylight.

Winifred Pike, about thirty, dark hair pinned back, a dark green wool coat over a high-necked blouse, a long skirt, stands at the office desk with one granted order sheet weighted under a brass weight, her satchel on the floor. Middle distance: a water jug, the bound return, the deal box. Background: the sash window, bright August sun.

Winifred Pike, about thirty, dark hair pinned back, a dark green wool coat over a high-necked blouse, a long skirt, kneels on a fresh socket in the turf with one spade in both hands, the hundred-foot tape coiled beside her. Middle distance: a concrete block, a lidded wooden box, a trowel. Background: open moor falling away north, low evening sun.

Winifred Pike, about thirty, dark hair pinned back, a dark green wool coat over a high-necked blouse, a long skirt, writes in the front of one field notebook held on her knee, the open moor behind her. Middle distance: the lidded wooden box, a length of tape, one primrose in the grass. Background: the fell, low sun.

Winifred Pike, about thirty, dark hair pinned back, a dark green wool coat over a high-necked blouse, a long skirt, stands on the moor shoulder with one field notebook closed against her palm, watching the weather come over the hill. Middle distance: the new lidded box, short grass, the beck below. Background: the fell and the reservoir wall, grey light.
